Job Title : Full Stack Java Developer
 
 Client : Top Financial Company 
 
Location : Rockville, MD
 
 Duration : 12+ Months (possible extension)
 
 
 
 WANTED! 
 
 • Capable of doing both front-end and back-end work

 • Development, JAVA, J2ee,SQL, coding, programming, spring Framework, Struts, JDBC and Hibernate 
 
• Strong knowledge of JUnit and Object Oriented Programming(OOP) concepts

 • Experience with AngularJS

 • Experience with HTML, CSS and JavaScript

 • Strong relational database programming skills

 
 
 GOOD TO HAVE! 
 
 • This person should be able to work well with others but also able to speak up his own opinion and question certain decisions/processes throughout the project. 
 
• Looking for an outspoken, confident individual not afraid to voice a controversy or critical opinion.

 

 • 08 years experience required 
 

• Bachelor's degree in a technical field such as computer science, computer engineering or related field required
